svg.title: Squadrone layered architecture
svg.desc: A five-layer view of the implemented Squadrone architecture. Web and command-line interfaces share the API contract. The API and scheduler persist intent, outbox, leases, limits, and recovery state in PostgreSQL while RabbitMQ provides delivery-only transport over five work queues and one diagnostic dead-letter queue. Scan, candidate, optional sandbox, deterministic report, and approval-gated submission workers form the execution plane; only scan, candidate, and sandbox images load the Squadrone engine package. PostgreSQL is authoritative, artifacts are content-addressed, and maintenance is on demand.

g.text: Control coordinates · execution performs · data persists.
Both interfaces call the API; neither owns workflow state or runs research.
Commands · read models · SSE · settings · artifacts
Outbox · leases · capacity · retry · pause · recovery
Delivery only · 5 primary queues + shared DLQ
RESEARCH PACKAGE · SCAN, CANDIDATE + SANDBOX WORKERS ONLY
Deterministic report · exact hash · ambiguous outcomes reconcile
Tasks + attempts · leases · outbox · candidates · budgets
Immutable bytes · provider journals · reconciliation custody
ON-DEMAND MAINTENANCE · PROVIDER JOURNALS · ARTIFACT RECONCILIATION / QUARANTINE
